component.name: Picasso Suite
component.summary: Non-linear video editor with a DaVinci Resolve-style interface

description.p: A video editor laid out like DaVinci Resolve, with Media, Photo, Cut, Edit, Fusion, Color, Fairlight and Deliver pages. It reads any format FFmpeg reads, exports H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, ProRes, DNxHR and more, and opens DaVinci Resolve projects. Not affiliated with Blackmagic Design.
